plugin.name: MIPster
plugin.title: MIPster
plugin.desc: MusicIP interface that exports Lyrion/APC play history and ratings to MusicIP and integrates MusicIP created chains or batches utilizing filters, recipes, moods and power searches from within Lyrion. Available features depend on version and type of MusicIP server employed.
plugin.changes: 1.3.1 can convert selected MIP tags (genre, artist, composer, orchestra, lyricist) to a separate one word CamelCase. This is very useful in recipes using overlap with multiple value tags. CountryPop won't overlap with PowerPop or TraditionalCountry. When MusicIP does not know the track a chain would continue from, MIPster now plays a random pick from the Filter; other MusicIP failures still repeat the track, with the reason shown in Live View.
plugin.creator: guptaas
